03 / BUY SMARTER

Make the package work for you.

VenuePractical buying advice
ICE HOUSEIts 10-pack and unlimited month both cost ฿4,000. Unlimited is cheaper per visit only above 10 visits within that month; the pack offers six months to use the visits.
Dip AriThe 10-pack saves ฿300 per weekend visit, versus ฿50 on weekdays. It lasts 12 months and is non-shareable.
ARAHThe five-pack is ฿780/visit. Committing to 10 only saves a further ฿10 per visit; start smaller unless attendance is certain.
Ice Bath Club฿5,000 monthly unlimited averages ฿416.67 at 12 visits. Confirm pack expiry and three-visit offer eligibility.
Fast & FitIce-only 10-pack is ฿300/visit; ice + sauna is ฿450. Decide whether the extra service is useful to you.
04 / HEALTH PERSPECTIVE

Feel good. Stay informed.

Pay for clean facilities, suitable temperature options, supervision and an enjoyable routine. Research suggests possible stress, sleep and wellbeing benefits, but evidence is limited. A more expensive or colder bath is not established to deliver better health outcomes.

Facility access time is not immersion time. Cold water can abruptly raise heart rate and blood pressure. Seek medical advice before trying it if you have cardiovascular disease or uncontrolled hypertension.

2025 systematic review · American Heart Association: cold-water risks
